capture_method: Manual transcription from successfully retrieved full archived HTML table A-1 TOTAL and full column header; no original webpage-byte hash.
access: Official archived HTML retrieved without account or payment; separate direct curl attempt returned HTTP 403.
public_use_basis: BLS publications are public domain except previously copyrighted photos and illustrations; this minimal numeric extract contains neither. BLS is attributed.
input_hash_scope: Local transcription and analysis JSON bytes only. Hashes detect changes relative to this manifest; they do not establish provenance or authenticity.

comparison_protocol.baseline: 100 times July 2024 SA unemployed divided by SA labor force; nearest-tenth rate and month change; exact thousand-person count change.
comparison_protocol.secondary_grid: SA and NSA, each July 2024 minus June 2024 and July 2024 minus July 2023; report all four.
comparison_protocol.rounding_diagnostics: Report raw exact ratios, nearest-tenth ratios, differences of displayed rates, and rounded differences of ratios. Preserve source integers.
comparison_protocol.timing_disclosure: This is a fixed teaching protocol designed with the historical result known, not a retrospectively claimed preregistration.
